newsitem.title: USA: Phelps Dodge can buy nearly 3 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Phelps Dodge can buy nearly 3 mln shares.

text.p: Phelps Dodge Corp said Friday it can buy nearly 3 million shares of its stock under the authorization announced last March.
At that time, the company noted, its current stock purchase authorization was increased to 10 million shares from 5 million.
During 1996, it said, the company purchased 4,297,300 shares at a total cost of $273.2 million.
Through January 15, 1997, the company has purchased a total of 7,022,900 common shares pursuant to this authorization; 2,977,100 shares remain authorized for purchase.
There were 64,711,000 common shares outstanding on December 31, it said. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
